notes: rk-nsex Tier A repair wave, LANDING-BLOCKER BL3 — 'Check 12 remains optional at the exact promotion boundary it is meant to protect.' The repo has a complete, reviewed extraction record for exactly this theorem, and the `status: cited` shard simply does not name it: it carries a genuine citation pair (Check 8 passes, `1/1 shard citations`) and an arbitrary contract. Pre-repair that exited 0 with a WARN and — worse — was excluded from the join denominator entirely, so the coverage line read `0/0 shard-record joins`: the check reported full coverage of a population it had defined to be empty. Two repairs, both visible here. (1) `.rk/config.json` `records: "required"` (declared in config_override) makes the absent join a structural ERROR `[record-required]`. (2) The denominator now counts every cited shard whether or not it names a record, so the same tree reads `0/1`. `aism_behavior: n/a`. Mutation-proof: setting the mode back to legacy returns this tree to WARN + exit 0 (that is `refs-40`, kept as its own fixture precisely so the two modes are pinned separately); dropping the denominator change restores the `0/0` blind spot with the ERROR still firing — the two are separately breakable and separately asserted. Siblings: `refs-38` (PMA with no origin), `refs-39` (literature PMA with no record), `refs-40` (the legacy control).
